name: Town - Default (seed v1)
description: A town, the top of the domain tree (town, districts, structures): its WorldGuard region, entry rules, spawn point and /warp settings. Districts are added on their own form by picking this town.

steps.description: Name the town. The name is what players see in game and what /warp and /navigate look for.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in game (entry messages, /warp, /navigate, menus) and in the web app. Commands find the town by this name, so keep it short and unique.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: A line or two about the town for admins and the web app, e.g. its role in the world.

steps.description: The WorldGuard region that covers the whole town, and whether players may walk in and out of it. Use Send to Minecraft and select the area in game with WorldEdit, or type the name of an existing region.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The town's WorldGuard region. Districts are checked against it and discovery, entry rules and navigation use it. A region drawn here is renamed domain_<id> and set up (parent, priority, flags) when the town is saved; its world becomes the town's world.

fields.label: Allow entry
fields.description: Players may walk into the town's region. Off keeps everyone out except staff with the region bypass permission, and the town is no /warp destination.

fields.label: Allow exit
fields.description: Players inside the town's region may walk out of it. Off keeps them inside until staff let them out.

fields.label: Entry rule on roads
fields.description: Applies: when players may not enter, /navigate routes avoid the roads through this region. Ignored: routes may use them (for places along a public street); the rule still holds at the border and for teleports. Empty = the setting for all towns on the Roads page.

steps.description: Where players arrive when they teleport or navigate to the town. Stand on the spot in game, facing the way arrivals should look, and use Send to Minecraft; the spot must be inside the town's region.

fields.label: Spawn point
fields.description: The arrival point for /warp and /navigate <town> spawn. Capture it in game, or pick an existing Location.

fields.label: Navigate to
fields.description: Where /navigate <town> leads when the player names no spot: Spawn = the spawn point above, Region = the nearest edge of the town's region. Leave empty to follow the setting for all towns on the Roads page.

steps.description: Whether players can /warp to the town's spawn point, and what that requires. Requirements are checked in this order: title, premium tier, discovery, price.

fields.label: Warp destination
fields.description: Lists the town in /warp and the teleport menu. It also needs a spawn point and Allow entry on. Off keeps the settings below but doesn't use them.

fields.label: Price (gems)
fields.description: Gems charged per warp, after the warmup. 0 = free. A permission group's /warp price setting can replace or multiply it.

fields.label: Minimum title
fields.description: Players whose experience is below this title can't warp here. Empty = no title needed.

fields.label: Minimum premium tier
fields.description: Only players whose highest premium tier has at least this group's weight may warp here. Only premium-tier groups can be picked. Empty = everyone.

fields.label: Discovered towns only
fields.description: Only players who have discovered the town (entered its region at least once) may warp here.

validationRules.errorMessage: The spawn point is outside the town's region. Pick a spot inside it.
validationRules.successMessage: The spawn point is inside the town's region.
